Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a tuition and fees payment plan at colleges and universities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a tuition and fees payment plan atcolleges and universities; adding a new section to chapter 28B.15 RCW;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that recent tuitionincreases have made avoiding indebtedness while attending colleges anduniversities much more difficult. The legislature also finds that somecolleges and universities have imposed stringent tuition and fee duedate policies, ignoring situations that may arise in the lives ofstudents, which impact their ability to make timely tuition payments.Therefore, it is the intent of the legislature that students be givenevery reasonable opportunity to avoid debt and make timely tuitionpayments, including exempting certain students from tuition and fee duedates for a reasonable amount of time to allow payments to be madethroughout the academic term.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning with the fall 2004 academic term, colleges and p. 1 HB 2827universities shall establish and make available an optional paymentplan to allow students to pay all tuition and fees throughout the termin approximately equal monthly payments. (2) Any degreeearning student shall be allowed to enroll in thepayment plan, except students receiving financial aid or scholarshipsthat cover the full cost of tuition and fees. (3) Colleges and universities may impose an administrative fee tohelp defray administrative costs associated with the payment plan, notto exceed onehalf of one percent of total tuition and fees due. (4) Enrollment in the payment plan shall exempt the student fromspecific lump sum payment due dates of tuition and fees of colleges anduniversities, and any corresponding penalties or surcharges. (5) Colleges and universities may disenroll a student from thepayment plan for delinquency of two or more payments. (6) Colleges and universities shall make available specificinformation regarding the availability of the payment plan to alleligible students. (7) Colleges and universities shall establish an enrollmentdeadline that does not precede the due date of tuition and fees for thecurrent term.
